description: Source code for the Installation Note doctype in ERPNext, handling validation, serial number checks, and status updates.

classes.name: InstallationNote
classes.description: Represents an installation note, extending TransactionBase, with methods for validation, serial number management, and status updates.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the InstallationNote object and sets up the status updater configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks including installation date and item table.

methods.name: is_serial_no_added
methods.description: Checks if serial number is provided when required, or if item is serialized when serial_no is given.

methods.name: is_serial_no_exist
methods.description: Verifies that serial numbers exist in the database.

methods.name: get_prevdoc_serial_no
methods.description: Retrieves serial numbers from the previous delivery note item.

methods.name: is_serial_no_match
methods.description: Ensures serial numbers match those from the previous delivery note.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial numbers for all items in the document.

methods.name: validate_installation_date
methods.description: Checks that installation date is not before delivery date.

methods.name: check_item_table
methods.description: Ensures that items are present in the document.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Sets the document status to Draft upon update.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Validates serial numbers, updates previous document status, and sets status to Submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Updates previous document status and sets status to Cancelled.
